answer: Annual Acme Cloud subscriptions may be refunded in full within 30 days of purchase. After the 30 day window refunds are prorated for unused months.
The Acme Cloud free tier default API rate limit is 60 requests per minute per API key.
SAML single sign-on support is available on the Acme Cloud Enterprise plan only.
Acme Cloud customers choose data storage in the US, EU, or Asia Pacific regions at workspace creation.
Acme Cloud retains automatic backups for 35 days on all plans.
